full_prompt_en: A square, brightly colored flat painting shows two mirrored pairs of stylized birds facing a central flowering stem. The largest birds stand on a shared horizontal bar, one on each side, with long purple-red wings, yellow necks, rounded blue heads, and pointed ocher beaks. Just above and inside them, two smaller bird heads project toward the center, making the pairings overlap like interlocking emblems. A tall green stem rises from a small patterned base at the bottom center, splits near the top, and ends in a yellow fan-shaped bloom. Red tulip-like shapes, green leaves, and blue teardrops branch symmetrically around it. On both outer edges, repeated oval leaves climb vertical stems toward round red-and-yellow flowers. Circular sun-like disks sit in the upper corners, and smaller patterned circles, curved fishlike motifs, dots, and loops crowd the bottom border. A saturated turquoise-blue ground fills the gaps. Every color block is bounded by thick black outlines, with inner lines marking wing feathers, leaf veins, and concentric flower centers. The palette is intense red, orange, yellow, teal, cobalt, purple, and green, with almost no tonal shading. Light is decorative and even rather than directional; the colors seem to glow against the black lines. The composition is tightly symmetrical but lively from the many small variations in repeated marks. The central plant divides and connects both sides, while layered birds, outer flowers, and lower border keep the whole frame densely rhythmic.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、颜色鲜亮的平面绘画呈现两组镜面对称的程式化鸟，朝向中央开花茎。最大的两只鸟分别站在共用水平横杆两侧，有长紫红翅、黄颈、圆蓝头和尖赭色喙。其上方靠内又伸出两颗较小鸟头，朝向中心，让成对形体像相互咬合的徽记。一根高绿茎从下方中央小纹样底座升起，靠上分叉，顶端是黄色扇形花。红色郁金香般形、绿叶和蓝色水滴形围着它对称分枝。两侧外缘重复椭圆叶子沿竖茎攀向红黄圆花。上方两角各有圆形太阳般纹盘，下方边框挤满较小花圆、弯曲鱼形纹、点和环。饱和青蓝底色填满缝隙。每块颜色都由厚黑线圈住，内部细线描出羽纹、叶脉和同心花心。配色强烈，包括红、橘、黄、青绿、钴蓝、紫和绿，几乎没有明暗塑形。光是均匀装饰性的，而非定向；颜色仿佛在黑线前发亮。构图紧密对称，但重复笔痕有许多微小变化，仍充满活力。中央植物分开又连接两侧，层叠鸟形、外侧花和下部边框使全幅节奏密集。
style_prompt_en: A flat, highly saturated graphic painting divides vivid red, orange, yellow, turquoise, cobalt, violet, and green areas with thick black contours. Mirrored large curved forms face a narrow central vertical axis, while smaller circles, teardrops, leaves, and looped marks fill nearly every interval. Inner linework adds featherlike stripes, concentric rings, and repeated small dots without tonal modeling. The blue ground keeps the dense warm shapes separated, and the black border gives the composition firm weight. Illumination is even and symbolic; visual hierarchy comes from size, hue contrast, and symmetry rather than shadows. The surface appears matte and slightly handmade, with crisp yet not mechanical edges. A central rising rhythm branches outward and returns through repeated side columns and a busy lower band, creating a joyous patterned pulse.
style_prompt_zh: 平面高饱和图形绘画以厚黑轮廓隔开鲜红、橘、黄、青绿、钴蓝、紫和绿的色块。镜像的大弧形体朝向狭窄中央竖轴，较小圆、泪滴、叶形和环状笔痕填满几乎每处间隙。内部线条加入羽纹般条线、同心圆环与重复小点，却不进行明暗塑形。蓝色底面把密集暖色形状分开，黑色边框给构图坚实重量。照明均匀、带象征性；视觉层级来自大小、色相对比和对称，而非阴影。表面哑光、略有手工感，边缘清楚却不机械。中央上升节奏向外分枝，再经重复侧列和繁忙下边带回，形成欢快纹样脉动。
theme_en: Two mirrored pairs of colorful birds among flowers
theme_zh: 花纹间两组镜面对称的彩色鸟
name: Norval Morrisseau
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
